<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Inkhorse</title>
<meta name="description" content="Inkhorse: write, turn pages and measure your book. The power to get it done, and then some!">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="Inkhorse">
<meta property="og:description" content="Write, turn pages and measure your book. Powered by StyleKnight &amp; Claude.">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://styleknight72.github.io/inkhorse/">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://styleknight72.github.io/inkhorse/card.png">
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
<meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://styleknight72.github.io/inkhorse/card.png">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f3f2ee;--card:#fff;--ink:#23211f;--mute:#6b665f;--line:#e2dfd8;--accent:#1f2a44;--onaccent:#fff}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#14161b;--card:#1d2027;--ink:#ece9e3;--mute:#a19c93;--line:#2d313a;--accent:#d9dde8;--onaccent:#14161b}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.5 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
.wrap{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 16px calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:12px 0 8px}
.logo{width:150px;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto 16px}
h1{font-size:40px;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 8px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pitch{font-size:19px;color:var(--mute);margin:0 auto 22px;max-width:30ch}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--accent);color:var(--onaccent);text-decoration:none;font:600 18px/1 -apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:16px 28px;border-radius:14px}
.sub{font:14px/1.4 -apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--mute);margin-top:10px}
h2{font-size:22px;margin:34px 0 12px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}
@media(min-width:480px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px}
.card b{display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
.card span{color:var(--mute);font-size:15.5px}
ol{padding-left:22px;margin:0}
li{margin:6px 0}
.note{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;color:var(--mute);font-size:16px}
footer{text-align:center;margin-top:40px;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
footer img{width:48px;height:auto;margin-bottom:8px}
footer i{display:block;margin-top:4px}
</style></head>
<body><div class="wrap">

<section class="hero">
<img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="StyleKnight horse logo">
<h1>Inkhorse</h1>
<p class="pitch">Write your book. Turn the pages. See it take shape.</p>
<a class="btn" href="app.html">Open Inkhorse</a>
<div class="sub">Free to try. Works in your phone's browser.</div>
</section>

<h2>What it does</h2>
<div class="grid">
<div class="card"><b>Write by voice or keyboard</b><span>Dictate a chapter or type it. Your words stay yours.</span></div>
<div class="card"><b>Listen to your draft</b><span>Read-aloud with rewind, replay and skip, like a tape deck.</span></div>
<div class="card"><b>Mark it, fix it later</b><span>Highlight a sentence, then jump from mark to mark when you revise.</span></div>
<div class="card"><b>See the real book</b><span>Page-flip preview with book page numbers and a running word count.</span></div>
</div>

<h2>Put it on your Home Screen</h2>
<ol>
<li>Open Inkhorse in Safari.</li>
<li>Tap the Share button.</li>
<li>Tap <b>Add to Home Screen</b>, then <b>Add</b>.</li>
</ol>

<h2>Good to know</h2>
<div class="note">Inkhorse saves your book on this device only. There is no account and no cloud copy. Export a copy of your book now and then to keep it safe.</div>

<footer>
<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><br>
Powered by StyleKnight &amp; Claude
<i>The power to get it done, and then some!</i>
</footer>

</div></body></html>
